Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose any number as long as the total play costs add up to 7 or less.
Card Q&A.q: From the cards revealed with this card's effect, can I choose cards whose total play costs add up to less than 7 on purpose?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. You may play any number of Digimon cards with [Chuumon], [Sukamon], or [Etemon] in their names whose total play costs add up to 7 or less among them without paying the costs. Trash the rest.
